007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.VectorIndex;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.VectorIndexAttributes;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * Sample for updating Select AI vector-index attributes in bulk.
019 *
020 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, obtain a
021 * {@link VectorIndex} object for an existing vector index, build a
022 * {@link VectorIndexAttributes} payload, call
023 * {@link VectorIndex#update(VectorIndexAttributes)}, and print whether the
024 * update succeeded.</p>
025 *
026 * <p>This sample changes database state by updating the vector index identified
027 * by {@code SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME}. Verify the vector index name and
028 * attributes before running it. Attribute mutability is determined by
029 * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI.UPDATE_VECTOR_INDEX}; if the database rejects an
030 * attribute, this sample logs the resulting {@link SelectAIException}.</p>
031 *
032 * <p>To run this sample, provide an object-storage location through
033 * {@code SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_LOCATION}. The location must be readable by the
034 * credential configured for the vector index and should reference documents
035 * suitable for embedding. When using Oracle Object Storage, ensure the
036 * credential, bucket or object URI, network access, and compartment/provider
037 * settings are configured before running the sample.</p>
038 *
039 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
040 * <ul>
041 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
042 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
043 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
044 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME</li>
045 * </ul>
046 *
047 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
048 * <ul>
049 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_MATCH_LIMIT - defaults to {@code 5}.</li>
050 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_REFRESH_RATE - defaults to {@code 1440}.</li>
051 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_ENABLE_SOURCES - enables or disables source
052 *       citations when supported by the database.</li>
053 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD - defaults to {@code 0}.</li>
054 * </ul>
055 *
056 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
057 * <pre>{@code
058 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
059 * }</pre>
060 *
061 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
062 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
063 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
064 * <pre>{@code
065 * mvn clean install
066 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
067 * }</pre>
068 *
069 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
070 * <pre>{@code
071 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
072 *   -d samples/out \
073 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/vectorindex/UpdateVectorIndexAttributesSample.java
074 * }</pre>
075 *
076 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
077 * <pre>{@code
078 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
079 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex.UpdateVectorIndexAttributesSample
080 * }</pre>
081 *
082 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
083 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
084 * and diagnostics.</p>
085 */
086public final class UpdateVectorIndexAttributesSample {
087    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(UpdateVectorIndexAttributesSample.class);
088
089    private UpdateVectorIndexAttributesSample() {
090    }
091
092    public static void main(String[] args) {
093        String indexName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME");
094
095        try {
096            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
097            VectorIndex vectorIndex = selectAI.vectorIndex(indexName);
098            VectorIndexAttributes attributes = buildVectorIndexAttributes();
099            boolean updated = vectorIndex.update(attributes);
100
101            System.out.printf("Update vector index '%s' attributes completed: %s%n", indexName, updated);
102            System.out.printf("Attribute payload: %s%n", attributes.toJson());
103        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
104            LOGGER.error("Failed to update Select AI vector index '{}'.", indexName, e);
105        }
106    }
107
108    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
109        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
110                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
111                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
112                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
113                .build();
114
115        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
116    }
117
118    private static VectorIndexAttributes buildVectorIndexAttributes() {
119        VectorIndexAttributes.Builder builder = VectorIndexAttributes.updateBuilder()
120                .matchLimit(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_MATCH_LIMIT", "5")))
121                .refreshRate(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_REFRESH_RATE", "1440")))
122                .similarityThreshold(Double.valueOf(
123                        envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD", "0")));
124
125        applyOptionalBoolean(builder::enableSources, "SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_ENABLE_SOURCES");
126
127        return builder.build();
128    }
129
130    private static void applyOptionalBoolean(BooleanAttributeSetter setter, String envName) {
131        String value = System.getenv(envName);
132        if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) {
133            setter.set(Boolean.valueOf(value));
134        }
135    }
136
137    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
138        String value = System.getenv(name);
139        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
140            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
141        }
142        return value;
143    }
144
145    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
146        String value = System.getenv(name);
147        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
148    }
149
150    @FunctionalInterface
151    private interface BooleanAttributeSetter {
152        void set(Boolean value);
153    }
154}
